children: (TheNewswire)
Hosted by Amy Lewis, CPB, the new audio and video podcast features conversations to help professionals learn, grow and succeed.

WINNIPEG, MB — TheNewswire — October 16, 2026 — Certified Professional Bookkeepers of Canada (CPB Canada), together with founding sponsor Payworks, today announced the launch of Reconcile This!, a new podcast bringing compelling guests, practical accounting insights and fresh ideas to Canada’s bookkeeping and accounting community.

Hosted by Amy Lewis, a Certified Professional Bookkeeper (CPB), Reconcile This! goes beyond the books to explore the people, decisions and experiences shaping the profession. New episodes arrive every two weeks, giving audiences the flexibility to listen on their favourite podcast platform or watch the conversations on YouTube.

From building a thriving practice and leading a team to navigating new technology and finding balance, the show connects professional growth with the real experiences of the people doing the work. Through candid conversations with practitioners, industry leaders and experts, Amy explores new ways of thinking and ideas audiences can bring into their businesses, careers and everyday lives.

“There is so much we can learn from one another when we make room for honest conversations,” said Amy Lewis, host of Reconcile This! “We want professionals to leave each episode with a fresh perspective, an idea they can put into action, and the encouragement to keep growing. This is a profession full of remarkable people, and I’m excited to share their stories.”

Developed and produced by The Davis Media Company Inc. in collaboration with CPB Canada, Reconcile This! was created to inspire thousands of bookkeeping and accounting professionals to learn, grow and succeed—while strengthening connections across the profession.

The launch is made possible through the support of Payworks as founding sponsor. Its investment helps bring these conversations to life and supports a shared commitment to the professionals who help Canadian businesses thrive.

"We're thrilled to be a part of something this meaningful for Canada's bookkeeping community," said Jaclyn Christie, Chief Marketing Officer at Payworks. "CPB Canada has long been a trusted voice for bookkeeping professionals from coast to coast, and our relationship with them is something we value immensely. Reconcile This! will be a fantastic resource for bookkeepers and accountants across Canada, it speaks directly to the real challenges and opportunities they navigate every day and Payworks is proud to help bring that conversation to life.”
The first episode of Reconcile This! is available October 16, with new episodes released every two weeks. Audiences can listen on Apple Podcasts, Spotify and Amazon Music, or watch on YouTube.
Watch, listen and follow the show: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ocMX8-PIvPA
About CPB Canada

Certified Professional Bookkeepers of Canada (CPB Canada) is a national, not-for-profit professional association dedicated to advancing Canada’s bookkeeping profession. Through its Certified Professional Bookkeeper (CPB) designation, professional development and community connections, CPB Canada supports bookkeepers in building their expertise, strengthening their careers and delivering trusted service. Visit cpbcan.ca.
About Payworks

Payworks is a proudly Canadian provider of cloud-based workforce management solutions, including payroll, human resources, time and absence management. Payworks helps Canadian businesses simplify the work of paying and managing their people. Visit payworks.ca.
About The Davis Media Company Inc.

The Davis Media Company Inc. develops and produces association publications, digital media and podcasts that help people learn, grow and succeed. Working with professional associations and industry partners across Canada and the United States, Davis creates platforms for sharing expertise, connecting communities and bringing meaningful stories to life. Visit www.davis.media
